evidence.title: OJO | AI Design Agent for UI & Product Prototypes

name: OJO
summary: Private-beta workspace where AI design agents turn prompts, images or URLs into UI designs and prototypes.
description: OJO is an agent-team workspace for product design, in private beta: you assemble an agent team with 200+ skill types (wireframe generation, UI/UX best practices, visual DNA, image search) and work on an infinite canvas that joins idea exploration, prototyping, code generation and live running. Prototypes come from a prompt, image or URL, and the design can ship as production-ready code that lives in your repo.
contains: prototypes from a prompt, image or URL
design exported as production-ready code into your repo
infinite canvas for exploration, prototyping, code generation and live running
